options.content:
An experimental view that keeps working measurement-reliability checks separate from future Defender Cost and baseline-vs-modified evaluation. Lifecycle accounting is limited to Telnet and MQTT, while malformed and I/O panels expose bounded telemetry/runtime outcomes.

Defender Cost and experiment sections remain implementation-status placeholders until their metric definitions and validation plans are approved.

panels.description: Scoped to Telnet/MQTT. total_connects is the canonical connection-start counter.
panels.title: Connections vs Completions

panels.description: Interpret near zero only after Telnet/MQTT sessions settle.
panels.title: Settled Lifecycle Gap

panels.description: Peer reset, close, timeout, or invalid packet can be normal scanner/client behavior. These are outcomes, not automatically system faults.
panels.title: Runtime I/O Outcomes

options.content:
# Implementation Status

This section is reserved for the Defender Cost metric branch.

Available but deferred from the selected core:
- aggregate Telnet/MQTT bytes sent
- aggregate Telnet/MQTT bytes received

Still required:
- mentor-approved cost question and experiment
- complete protocol coverage or an explicit Telnet/MQTT-only scope
- CPU and memory from existing container/process monitoring
- an agreed cost-per-trapped-time interpretation

Byte panels are withheld because partial instrumentation would imply complete defender-cost coverage. This section becomes active after the Defender Cost branch and validation plan are approved.

```text
Defender Cost
|-- Network bytes
|-- CPU / memory
`-- Cost per trapped second
```

# Implementation Status

This section is reserved for the first controlled baseline-vs-modified Telnet experiment.

Available now:
- completed-session duration histogram
- early-disconnect ratio, provisional
- bounded protocol actions
- measurement-reliability checks

Still required:
- approved modified behavior
- bounded experiment identity or separate run configuration
- repeatable baseline and modified traffic runs
- agreed comparison and defender-cost criteria

No comparison panel is shown until those inputs exist, preventing empty or misleading PromQL.

```text
Baseline vs Modified
|-- p50 / p95 duration
|-- Early disconnect
|-- Interaction depth
`-- Defender cost
```
